description.description: one line shown in the picker and the profile directory

skills.description: all, or the only skills the chat is offered (Claude harness)

can_start.description: all, or the profile ids this profile may spawn

write_scope.description: work_dir: Edit/Write/NotebookEdit outside the work folder and scratch are refused

turn_context.description: blocks hos injects each turn when they change

handoff_skill.description: skill a refresh or handoff runs

handoff_at.description: share of the handoff line that refreshes the chat by itself; null = hos policy

context_refresh.description: true: the chat refreshes in place (Refresh context button, and handoff_at refreshes instead of handing off): it updates PROGRESS.md, then hos clears its context in the same chat

color.description: hex colour: the chat tab takes a tint of it and the composer border the full colour

harness.description: default harness for its chats (claude, or the id of an added harness); an explicit pick or spawn agent wins; not installed = today's default

models.description: per harness id, the default model and effort for its chats; an explicit pick or spawn wins; a model the harness lacks is skipped

hide_tools.description: tools its chats never get: hos bus tools by bare name (server_start) and Claude built-ins by name (Agent, WebSearch, NotebookEdit); the five every chat needs can't be hidden

browser.description: true: its chats start with the Browser on (the chip's default, and spawns that don't set browser); claude harness only

picker.description: false: spawn-only, left out of the composer's profile picker but still spawnable
